test_inverse_dynamics: test that expert actions are computed correctly from inverse dynamics in the Nocturne simulation
create_sim_with_expert_control: create a Nocturne simulation from a scenario file with objects set to expert control mode
run_simulation_step: run a single simulation step with a given time delta using the Nocturne Simulation step method
get_expert_action: get the expert action for a specific object at a given time step from the scenario
compare_object_states: compare speed and heading between test and ground truth simulation objects using numpy isclose
